5.name: Episode 1
5.overview: A charming new shopping centre owner makes an appearance. René continues to grapple with the consequences of her past. Marco refuses to let her go. Karla upsets her loved ones.

5.name: Episode 2
5.overview: Karla shocks Sanet, and Liam fights to keep Rene as his coach. Gihan begins to take his place in the community.

5.name: Episode 3
5.overview: Theresa has a surprise for Gys. Gihan discovers something about Zelda and focuses his attention on her.

5.name: Episode 4
5.overview: Gihan is excited to meet Gys. The shopping centre receives dangerous visitors. Karla's attitude upsets Jacques.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Rene is worried that Liam is pushing himself too hard. Karla gets some ‘tough love’ from Sanet. Zelda is visited by two men.

5.name: Episode 6
5.overview: An incident at the coffee shop shakes up the entire community. Natalie is unhappy with the quality of Karla's work at Skinvestment. Leandri and Rene clash over Marco.

5.name: Episode 7
5.overview: Liam is struggling to keep his head above water after yet another setback. An unexpected arrival at the Swarts property stirs up emotions for Gys. Gihan is put under pressure.

5.name: Episode 8
5.overview: Rene starts wondering if Liam is still on his medication. Gys is pleased, and Karla tries to make the best of her job at Skinvestment.

5.name: Episode 9
5.overview: Liam causes a scene at a press conference. Karla shocks Sanet with an announcement. Gys makes a major decision regarding Aiden.

5.name: Episode 10
5.overview: Jacques discovers that Aiden has already moved in and is not happy about it. Sanet and Karla are at odds over her future. Liam has vanished, and Rene is frantic with worry.

5.name: Episode 11
5.overview: Karla starts her new job. Gys enjoys his time with Aiden. Things turn ugly between Marco and Liam.

5.name: Episode 12
5.overview: There is major disagreement between Karla and Sanet regarding her working at Bianca’s. Jacques remains uncomfortable about Aiden’s presence. Gihan makes Zelda an offer.

5.name: Episode 13
5.overview: Jacques remains suspicious of Aiden after the family dinner. Liam leaves for Hawaii. Juvan’s late-night escapades begin to take their toll on Karla.

5.name: Episode 14
5.overview: Jacques struggles to accept Aiden. Lettie’s financial pressure mounts. Karla’s attempt to build a new life away from swimming leads to conflict.

5.name: Episode 15
5.overview: Tension between Karla and Katinka reaches breaking point. A new idea takes root in Henry’s mind. Jacques confronts Aiden.

5.name: Episode 16
5.overview: Gys and Jacques clash over Aiden. Lettie gives Karla perspective. Lettie is not interested in Henry's proposal.

5.name: Episode 17
5.overview: Jacques is trying to keep the new club on track. Karla is still grappling with her identity. Henry is chasing his food truck dream with everything he has.

5.name: Episode 18
5.overview: Gihan spends time at the club trying to win over Jacques and Tshepo. This annoys Justus. Zelda makes a bold decision. Henry receives good news.

5.name: Episode 19
5.overview: Gys realizes the true extent of his losses. Henry’s exciting new business opportunity puts him on a collision course with Lettie, while Zelda and Gihan’s negotiations become increasingly complicated.

5.name: Episode 20
5.overview: Gys and Jacques take a step forward to mend their broken relationship. Henry finally wins Lettie’s support, and Zelda strikes a dangerous deal.

5.name: Episode 21
5.overview: Theresa and Lettie are worried about Sanet. Gys surprises everyone at the pool. Zelda sees something strange in her agreement with Gihan.

5.name: Episode 22
5.overview: Gihan shows his true colours to Zelda. Gys and Aiden start work on Henry’s food truck. Sanet reaches an important milestone.

5.name: Episode 23
5.overview: Zelda receives a dangerous offer from Gihan, Sanet is confronted by an unexpected visitor from her past, and Henry battles his nerves ahead of his food truck venture.

5.name: Episode 24
5.overview: Gihan fishes about Zelda and Cloete’s past. Eurika wonders why Sanet recommended an inferior club to her. Henry realises he needs help with his food truck.

5.name: Episode 25
5.overview: The pressure on Henry’s family life begins to mount. A skeleton tumbles out of Sanet’s closet. Gihan’s patience with Gys is starting to run out.

5.name: Episode 26
5.overview: Sanet fights to secure Tobias a place at Swartmarlyne. Henry and Juvan conjure up a new plan for the food truck.

5.name: Episode 27
5.overview: Gys makes a big decision which affects the club. A new development causes strain between Henry and Lettie. Zelda cautions Gihan.

5.name: Episode 28
5.overview: Wanda sees something that grabs her attention. Jacques discovers Tobias’ secret, and Zelda reveals the truth to Gihan.

5.name: Episode 29
5.overview: Lettie's suspicions grow. Sanet digs into her past, and Gihan turns his charm on Leandri.

5.name: Episode 30
5.overview: Eurika is desperate about Tobias, who refuses to part with his swimming goggles. Someone’s unexpected arrival in Boskruin leads to problems for Zelda.

5.name: Episode 31
5.overview: Against the electric backdrop of the gala, personal conflicts and fierce rivalries collide as the swimmers prepare for the day's showcase event.

5.name: Episode 32
5.overview: Sanet tries to bury the past. Justus begins to question what really happened at the gala, and Lettie is excited about someone’s arrival.

5.name: Episode 33
5.overview: Justus questions Gihan's role in Marco's disqualification, and someone drives a painful wedge between Sanet and Eurika.

5.name: Episode 34
5.overview: Gihan surprises both Leandri and Frans. Marco takes his future into his own hands, and Boskruin helps Lettie and Henry.

5.name: Episode 35
5.overview: Zaz is jealous when Gihan goes on his date with Leandri. Jacques confronts Aiden about his meddling. Sanet goes into action after reading Alexander’s book.

5.name: Episode 36
5.overview: Lettie panics when she’s overwhelmed with questions about the previous night. Marco and Justus have an altercation at the pool with serious consequences.

5.name: Episode 37
5.overview: A shocking incident leaves the Viljoens reeling. Karla makes it clear how she feels about her mom’s secrets.

overview: The club belongs to Gys Swarts, whose sons Rossouw and Jacques are involved in the family enterprise. Gys's grandchildren Karla and Johan also swim for the club, bringing the demands of training and competition directly into the family circle. Can Gys keep ownership, family expectation and sporting ambition from pulling the club in different directions?
title: Deep Waters
